name: Fairie Fever
body:
Type disease (contact); Save Fortitude DC 14

Onset 1d4 days; Frequency 1/day

Effect 1d3 Dex damage, if the target accumulates more than 3 points of Dex damage, the target begins to glow slightly, causing a –5 penalty on Stealth checks; Cure 2 consecutive saves
